sources.title: XAG112 UI navigation
sources.actuallyRead: Consistent navigation order and predictable focus throughout the game.
sources.application: Original temporary life-reading returns, new-phase safe return and cross-run dialog invalidation must remain predictable.

sources.title: IDBDatabase.close
sources.actuallyRead: Close takes effect after outstanding transactions complete and prevents new transactions; closing a connection does not cancel accepted transactions.
sources.application: Readonly navigation/modal closure cannot become cancellation or a new authorization; native quota/old-intent retry and other-page restore are observed as separate actual transactions.
